dismissed.title: WebApp writes fail once a stored line already has quantity < 1
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn, and the withdrawal is supported: AddAsync starts lines at 1, SetQuantityAsync removes lines with quantity <= 0, and commit() clamps to >= 1, so the WebApp cannot store a line below 1. BUG-8 does not ask for cleanup of old data.
